input-field.name: bookingTimeout
input-field.label: Expiration time (minutes)
Reservierungsdauer (in Minuten)
input-field.helpText: How long the slot will be reserved before it becomes available again if not paid.
Wie lange der Termin reserviert bleibt, bevor er wieder verfügbar wird, falls nicht bezahlt wird.

input-field.name: cancellationTimeout
input-field.label: Cancellation period (hours)
Stornierungsfrist (в Stunden)
input-field.helpText: The time window in hours during which the customer can cancel their booking.
Zeitfenster in Stunden, in dem der Kunde seine Buchung stornieren kann.

input-field.name: loyaltyThreshold
input-field.label: Bookings required for 1 free credit
Buchungen erforderlich für 1 Gratis-Guthaben
input-field.helpText: How many paid bookings a customer needs to get one free slot.
